summary: The database connection pool ran out and orders failed to save; an unhandled exception crashed the process.

findings.title: Database connection pool exhausted while orders were being stored, so checkout requests failed and customers saw errors until the pool recovered after the nightly batch job released its DB connections
findings.explanation: Every pooled database connection is in use, so new requests cannot reach the database and orders fail to save.
findings.suggested_action: Look for connections that are not disposed, then check the Max Pool Size in the connection string.
